question: The Wahabi Movement was started by Syed Ahmad, of _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rae Bareli**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Wahabi Movement** was an Islamic revivalist movement led by **Syed Ahmad Barelvi**.
 
• It originated in **Rae Bareli**, located in present-day Uttar Pradesh, India.
 
• The movement was inspired by the teachings of **Shah Waliullah** and aimed to purify Islam from un-Islamic practices and return to its original principles.
 
• It emphasized the concepts of **monotheism** (Tawhid) and the rejection of idolatry (Shirk).
 
• Syed Ahmad Barelvi declared a **jihad** against the British colonial rule and their allies, with the ultimate goal of establishing an Islamic state.
 
• The movement had significant influence in northern India, especially in **Bihar, Bengal, and the North-West Frontier Province**.
 
• It also played a role in uniting people against the colonial powers, which indirectly contributed to the freedom struggle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Hyderabad**__

 __
 
• **Hyderabad** is a historic city in the southern state of Telangana, India.
 
• It has been a center of culture and history, known for landmarks like the **Charminar** and the **Golconda Fort**.
 
• It was the seat of the **Nizams of Hyderabad**, who were prominent rulers during the British colonial period.
 
• However, Hyderabad is not associated with the origins of the Wahabi Movement.
 
 
 
• **Amritsar**__
 __
 
• **Amritsar** is a city in the state of Punjab and a prominent center of **Sikhism**.
 
• It is known for the **Golden Temple**, the most sacred site in Sikhism, and its rich cultural heritage.
 
• Amritsar has no direct connection to the Wahabi Movement.
 
 
 
• **Jhansi**__
 
 
• **Jhansi** is a historic city in Uttar Pradesh, famous for its association with **Rani Lakshmibai**, one of the leading figures in the Indian Rebellion of 1857.
 
• It is known for the **Jhansi Fort** and its role in India’s struggle for independence.
 
• However, Jhansi is not linked to the Wahabi Movement, as it was associated with a different historical context.
